name: banded-internal-rotation
instructions:
1. Assume a standing position with your elbow flexed to 90 degrees while holding a band anchored to a sturdy object.
2. Rotate your hand in towards your body while keeping your elbow tight to your torso.
3. Slowly lower the band back to the starting position under control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
